title: Astro and the Singing Asteroid
logline: A daring pocket robot follows a starlight compass into deep space to heal a singing asteroid that guides lost travelers.

character_bible.name: Astro
character_bible.visual_appearance: palm-sized explorer robot with brushed sky-blue chrome plating and expressive round teal optics
character_bible.signature_clothing: utility belt made of solar-yellow synthetic weave with magnetic pouches
character_bible.distinct_accessories: glowing bronze starlight compass antenna on his crown

scenes.title: Drifting in the Nebula
scenes.narrative_text: Astro hummed softly as his small scout ship coasted through the iridescent lilac clouds of the Orion Nebula, scanning for rare cosmic frequencies.
scenes.audio_script: Astro hummed softly as his small scout ship coasted through the iridescent lilac clouds of the Orion Nebula, scanning for rare cosmic frequencies.
scenes.image_prompt: retro-futuristic storybook art, cozy spaceship cockpit overlooking glowing purple nebula and twinkling stars, Astro (palm-sized sky-blue robot with round teal eyes and yellow belt), starlight compass glowing, sleek futuristic shapes, storybook art

scenes.title: The Song of the Stars
scenes.narrative_text: Suddenly, his starlight compass spun wildly. A warm melody echoed through his communication console—gentle chimes carrying a rhythmic galactic song.
scenes.audio_script: Suddenly, his starlight compass spun wildly. A warm melody echoed through his communication console, gentle chimes carrying a rhythmic galactic song.
scenes.image_prompt: retro-futuristic storybook art, Astro the sky-blue robot looking at glowing soundwaves on a holographic screen, starlight compass on his crown pulsing with golden light, starry space vista outside cockpit, storybook art

scenes.title: The Crystalline Wanderer
scenes.narrative_text: Following the soundwaves, Astro encountered an ancient asteroid covered in glowing blue harmonic crystals that resonated with every passing solar wind.
scenes.audio_script: Following the soundwaves, Astro encountered an ancient asteroid covered in glowing blue harmonic crystals that resonated with every passing solar wind.
scenes.image_prompt: retro-futuristic storybook art, majestic floating asteroid covered in giant glowing sapphire crystals in deep space, Astro the small robot floating gently with magnetic thrusters, cosmic glow, vibrant, storybook art

scenes.title: A Broken Harmony
scenes.narrative_text: Astro noticed a rogue meteor had jammed the central crystalline spire. With careful robotic precision and his toolkit, he cleared the obstruction and tuned the crystal node.
scenes.audio_script: Astro noticed a rogue meteor had jammed the central crystalline spire. With careful robotic precision and his toolkit, he cleared the obstruction and tuned the crystal node.
scenes.image_prompt: retro-futuristic storybook art, Astro the sky-blue robot using tiny laser toolkit on glowing crystal spire on asteroid surface, dazzling blue and gold light beams radiating into space, storybook art

scenes.title: The Symphony of the Cosmos
scenes.narrative_text: The asteroid burst into full celestial melody, guiding lost starships safely through the nebula. Astro smiled, his compass spinning in perfect harmony with the galaxy.
scenes.audio_script: The asteroid burst into full celestial melody, guiding lost starships safely through the nebula. Astro smiled, his compass spinning in perfect harmony with the galaxy.
scenes.image_prompt: retro-futuristic storybook art, Astro sitting happily atop glowing singing asteroid, brilliant beams of melodic light reaching distant friendly starships, vast colorful cosmic horizon, triumph and peace, storybook art

moral_or_takeaway: When we listen closely and repair what is broken, our actions create harmony across the universe.
